title: Evidence Binding Record
description: A single binding linking a thesis claim to a source with an assigned evidence role. Version 1.0.

binding_id.description: Unique identifier for this binding record, e.g. 'BIND-CH2-001'

chapter_function.description: Functional role of the chapter, e.g. 'introduction', 'literature_review', 'methodology', 'architecture', 'evaluation', 'results', 'discussion', 'conclusion'

claim_text.description: The exact sentence or passage from the thesis that makes a claim. Example (RU): 'BERT представляет собой трансформер-энкодер, обученный на корпусе из 3.3 млрд слов.'

claim_type.description: Classification of the claim made in the text

required_evidence_roles.description: Evidence roles needed to support this claim

matched_source_ids.description: IDs of sources matched to this binding, e.g. ['SRC-2024-001', 'SRC-2023-042']

evidence_strength.description: Strength of the evidence binding: strong (peer-reviewed, direct match), medium (relevant but indirect), weak (tangentially related), none (no source matched)

gap_status.description: Current coverage status: covered (fully supported), partial (partially supported), missing (no support), not_needed (no citation required)

recommended_action.description: Actionable recommendation to resolve the gap, e.g. 'Find peer-reviewed source for BERT architecture definition'

recommended_query.description: Suggested search query to find a missing source, e.g. 'BERT architecture transformer encoder pre-training'

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this binding was created
